title: partner-cloud-marketplace-weekly-sync-prep
content:
Weekly partner/cloud marketplace sync - prep (notes + agenda)
Owner: Jamie Rivera
Attendees (TBD): Ari Gupta (AWS PM), Maya Thompson (GCP partnerships), Kevin Liu (Azure channel), Heather (sales ops), external rep: Lara from AWS Marketplace
Date/Time: Fri 2026-02-27 09:00 PT (confirm)

Objectives for this sync:
- Quick alignment on ongoing listings and pending approvals across AWS/GCP/Azure.
- Surface any blockers in onboarding or billing flows for new customers.
- Decide next steps for marketplace packaging updates and docs.
- Agree owners and deadlines for follow-ups.

Running order / proposed agenda (30 min):
1) 5m - Quick roll call + wins (recent listings, new customers)
   - Note: congratulate GCP team for Batch inference listing last week (Maya)
2) 8m - Marketplace pipeline health (status by cloud)
   - AWS: pending compliance review for private-deployments image (Ari)
   - GCP: billing integration tests failing for 2 customers (Maya)
   - Azure: legal review complete, awaiting SKU mapping (Kevin)
3) 8m - Docs / packaging ask (who owns publishing changes)
   - Proposed change: split onboarding doc into "Self-Serve" vs "Enterprise" flows (Jamie draft)
4) 6m - Action items & owners (capture with deadlines)
5) 3m - Quick sync on next steps, scheduling next meeting

Pre-read / things to bring to the call:
- Short status bullets (one-liners) for your cloud: new listings this week, stuck items, any escalations
- Link to the onboarding guide draft: CONFLUENCE:marketplace-onboarding-guides-3
- JIRA board snapshot: PMKT- backlog (link in linked_artifacts)

Key open questions to surface:
- AWS: ETA on compliance review for private-deployments image? If >1 week, fallback plan?
- GCP: Which customers hit billing test failures and can we reproduce in staging? (Maya)
- Azure: Are there map collisions in SKU naming we need to resolve before publishing?
- Pricing table canonical source: should pricing live in the console or in our marketplace packaging repo? (proposal: repo + automated sync)

Metrics / signals to watch (quick numbers to call out):
- Listings published this month by cloud (goal: 3+ each)
- Time-to-publish median (target <10 business days)
- Number of onboarding support tickets opened after publish (goal <5 in first 30 days)

Draft action items (to be confirmed on call):
- Ari: follow up with AWS compliance team for private-deployments image; report ETA by Mon 2026-03-01.
- Maya: reproduce billing failures and create debug checklist; assign to eng contact (SRE on-call) by Tue 2026-03-02.
- Kevin: confirm SKU mapping sheet and flag collisions; share updated sheet by Wed 2026-03-03.
- Jamie: publish split onboarding doc draft (Self-Serve vs Enterprise) to Confluence and tag owners; link in channel by Fri 2026-02-28.
- Heather: validate marketplace contract template updates for Azure and share redline by Thu 2026-03-04.
- Team: set up automation proposal for pricing sync (owner: product-ops) — draft by next weekly sync.

Notes / scratchpad (things to follow up offline):
- Consider a short "marketplace readiness checklist" (1-pager) for partner reps to reduce back-and-forth.
- Revisit our default SKU naming rules — get platform-eng input (maybe SVC- prefix?)
- Potential win: offer a pre-baked demo image for "private-deployments" customers to speed approvals. Need infra & security review.

Post-meeting follow-up template (for whoever takes notes):
- TL;DR (1 line)
- Attendees + absentees
- Decisions made
- Action items (owner + due date)
- Links: confluence / jira / PRs

Quick reminders before the call:
- Bring one concrete ask (e.g., "I need ETA", "I need a PR review", "I need legal redline")
- Keep the sync tight; escalate bigger blockers to separate deeper triage with eng/legal

----
Scratchpad history / earlier notes: 
- 2026-02-13: initial brainstorm about splitting onboarding doc (Jamie)
- 2026-02-18: Maya reported first billing test failure (GCP)
- 2026-02-19: Ari pinged AWS rep re: compliance queue, no ETA yet

Links referenced in notes (quick):
- Confluence: marketplace-onboarding-guides-3
- JIRA: PMKT-89 (marketplace pipeline board)
- GH PR: redwood/marketplace-integration#42 (packaging automation proposal)

Next sync: propose Fri 2026-03-06 09:00 PT (confirm availability)

End of prep doc.
